summary: Sarah Schultz, 31, of Tulsa, Oklahoma, paddleboarding on the Gunnison River, fell off her board near McCabe's Lane (County Road 32) west of Gunnison and was swept into a tree in the river; the 11:15 a.m. call brought Gunnison County deputies, Swift Water Rescue, and Gunnison Fire/EMS, who recovered her; she was taken to Gunnison Valley Hospital, flown to Grand Junction, and did not survive.
location: Gunnison River near McCabe's Lane (County Road 32), west of Gunnison
responding_agency: Gunnison County Sheriff's Office; Gunnison Swift Water Rescue; Gunnison Fire and EMS
